lead: Sonia Gandhi is a widely followed Italian politician, born on 9 December 1946 in Lusiana.
As of 2026, she is 79 years old, and her birth date places her under the Sagittarius sign.

She has held the office of President of the Indian National Congress and Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha and has been recognised with the honorary doctorate of the Vrije Universiteit Brussel.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sonia Gandhi: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Sonia Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sonia Gandhi was born on 9 December 1946 in Lusiana, and holds Italian and Indian nationality.
Her listed education includes University of Cambridge.
She is recorded as speaking Italian, Hindi, English and French.

sections.heading: Sonia Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician as her main occupation.

She has held the following offices: President of the Indian National Congress (1998–2017), Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha (1998–2004), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Member of the 17th Lok Sabha and President of the Indian National Congress (2019–2022). She is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
